# Claude Code Undocumented Permissions

Permissions decide which actions Claude Code may do alone.
Many permission rule names and checks are not in the official docs.
Of its 122 rows, 121 is found only in the program, and 1 works only behind a flag or a gate.
Anthropic can change or remove each item in any release.

## Found Only in the Program

121 items are in the program but not in the official docs.
These are the most useful ones.

- `CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_SANDBOX_SHOW_INDICATOR`: Shows `SandboxedBash` as the tool name. See [Permissions and Sandbox Sandbox](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Sandbox).
- `asyncAgent`: A background agent has no prompt surface. See [Permissions and Sandbox Modes](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Modes).
- `CLAUDE_BG_SESSION_PERMISSION_RULES`: JSON with `allow`, `deny`, `addDirs` for a background session. See [Permissions and Sandbox Auto Mode](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Auto-Mode).
- `permissionPromptTool`: An MCP permission prompt tool decided. See [Permissions and Sandbox Modes](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Modes).
- `outsideReadsBlocked`: `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`. See [Permissions and Sandbox Modes](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Modes).
- `subcommandResults`: Parts of a compound command decided. See [Permissions and Sandbox Modes](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Modes).
- `Self-Approval`: Approving a pull request that the agent wrote. See [Permissions and Sandbox Auto Mode Soft Deny](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Auto-Mode-Soft-Deny).
- `sandboxOverride`: A command runs outside the sandbox. See [Permissions and Sandbox Modes](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Modes).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_SANDBOX_LEAVE_PARENT_FOLDERS_ALONE`: Windows: skip the parent-folder grants. See [Permissions and Sandbox Sandbox](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Sandbox).
- `Self-Modification`: Editing the permissions, hooks, or sandbox config of the agent itself. See [Permissions and Sandbox Auto Mode Soft Deny](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Auto-Mode-Soft-Deny).

## Behind a Flag or a Gate

1 items work only when a flag or a gate is on.
This is the whole list.

- `sandbox.network.tlsTerminate.caCertPath`, `.caKeyPath`: Experimental TLS termination. See [Permissions and Sandbox Sandbox](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox-Sandbox).
